intro: Big portions and regional pride: burgers, barbecue that varies state by state, Southern comfort food and diner breakfasts.
flavours: Beef, cheese, barbecue smoke, butter, corn, maple syrup
hk: American burger chains like Shake Shack and Five Guys and Texas-style smokehouses are popular in Hong Kong.

dishes.name: Cheeseburger
dishes.what: Grilled beef patty with melted cheese in a bun; smash burgers are the current craze.

dishes.name: Hot dog
dishes.what: Frankfurter in a soft bun with mustard, onions and relish; New York and Chicago argue over toppings.

dishes.name: Texas BBQ brisket
dishes.what: Beef brisket smoked low and slow for 12+ hours until it has a black bark and pink smoke ring.

dishes.name: Buffalo wings
dishes.what: Fried chicken wings tossed in vinegary hot sauce and butter, with blue cheese dip and celery.

dishes.name: Southern fried chicken
dishes.what: Buttermilk-soaked chicken in a crunchy seasoned crust.

dishes.name: Macaroni and cheese
dishes.what: Macaroni in a rich cheddar cheese sauce.

dishes.name: New England clam chowder
dishes.what: Creamy soup of clams and potatoes, served with oyster crackers or in a bread bowl.

dishes.name: Lobster roll
dishes.what: Maine classic: chunks of lobster in a buttered, toasted hot-dog bun.

dishes.name: Philly cheesesteak
dishes.what: Philadelphia's sandwich of thinly sliced griddled beef and melted cheese in a long roll.

dishes.name: Deep-dish pizza
dishes.what: Chicago's tall, pie-like pizza with cheese under a chunky tomato sauce.

dishes.name: Pancakes
dishes.what: Thick, fluffy breakfast pancakes stacked with butter and maple syrup.

dishes.name: Apple pie
dishes.what: Double-crust pie of cinnamon-spiced apples, served with vanilla ice cream ('à la mode').
